History_of_Present_Illness.content: Marked anxiety for 2 months coinciding with starting a new job at a fashion retailer head office with a hostile boss, leading to dreading work
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: 2-mo hx marked anxiety; coincides w/ starting new job (fashion retailer HO); hostile boss; dreads work

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Goes to bed between 22:00 and 23:00 with prolonged sleep onset latency and wakes before alarm with palpitations, achieving approximately 3–4 hours of shallow sleep per night
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Sleep: bed 22:00–23:00; prolonged SOL; wakes before alarm w/ palpitations; ~3–4 h/night; shallow sleep

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Irregular palpitations lasting minutes up to 10 minutes, especially in the morning when fearing being late
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Palpitations: irregular; mins–10 min, esp AM when fearing lateness

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Has feared having a heart attack during palpitations
Initially no chest pain, but reports chest is painful when heart is beating fast
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: CP: initially no, but “painful when heart beating fast”

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Very low daytime energy with anhedonia, feeling on edge, avoiding socializing, and reduced running and tennis
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Daytime: very low energy; anhedonia; on edge; avoids socializing; reduced running/tennis

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Public transport, especially the tube when warm and airless, acts as a trigger for symptoms
No work absences but often considers calling in sick
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Work: no absences; often considers calling in sick

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Appetite without significant change, eating regularly but with increased chocolate intake
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Appetite: no sig change; eating regularly; ↑ chocolate

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Persistently low mood including weekends with no prior similar episodes
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Mood: persistently low incl weekends; no prior similar episodes

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Has talked to mother about symptoms, has not had counseling, and is open to one-to-one therapy
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Help to date: talked to mother; no counseling; open to 1:1 therapy

Family_History.content: Mother has a past history of depression

Social_and_Family_History.content: Drinks alcohol heavily on Fridays and Saturdays above recommended limits plus an occasional glass midweek
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: etOH heavy Fri/Sat (over limits) + occasional glass midweek

Social_and_Family_History.content: Works at a fashion retailer head office with a hostile boss
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: starting new job (fashion retailer HO); hostile boss

Assessment.content: Work-related anxiety for approximately 2 months with insomnia, palpitations, anhedonia, and avoidance; no panic attacks; denies suicidal ideation
Assessment.source_text: 1) Work-related anxiety x ~2 mo w/ insomnia, palpitations, anhedonia/avoidance; no panic attacks; denies SI

Assessment.content: Palpitations are likely anxiety-related, irregular and situational, with chest discomfort only when heart rate is rapid
Assessment.source_text: 2) Palpitations likely anxiety-related (irregular, situational); chest discomfort only w/ rapid HR

Assessment.content: Alcohol use above recommended limits with occasional tobacco use
Assessment.source_text: 4) EtOH use above limits; occasional tobacco

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient to self-refer to NHS Talking Therapies for CBT; link to be sent
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Self-refer to NHS Talking Therapies (CBT); link to be sent

Plan_of_Care.content: Start recommended online anxiety resources immediately
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Start recommended online anxiety resources now

Plan_of_Care.content: Provide sleep hygiene resources and review them
Arrange basic blood tests to evaluate palpitations via support line
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Basic blood tests to eval palpitations; arrange via support line

Plan_of_Care.content: Consider starting medications if there is non-response to therapy and online resources
Plan_of_Care.source_text: consider meds if non-response to therapy/resources

Plan_of_Care.content: Safety-net advice to call back if symptoms worsen, if unable to cope with work or activities of daily living, or if no improvement
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Safety-net: call back if worsening, unable to cope w/ work/ADLs, or no improvement
